gem_guidance.text: The Collar of the Aldor is the best headpiece for phase 1, due to being able to equip the Chaotic Skyfire Diamond gem, which provides higher damage output than other headpieces that technically might have higher stats or even better set bonuses. The same applies to the optional pieces, which far outperform even the tailoring headpiece if equipped with the meta gem.

title: Arcane Mage DPS Phase 1 Best in Slot (BiS) - TBC Classic - Wowhead
